_comment: INF-CR-006: the secrets the Platform sweeps workflow passes to `pnpm cron:sweeps`. Keys are GitHub secret names; values are the environment variable each one becomes. GitHub forbids secret names starting with GITHUB_, so those are stored with a ZIKI_ prefix. Read by scripts/cron/set-github-sweep-secrets.mjs. .github/workflows/sweeps.yml lists the same names one by one (GitHub holds back workflows that load all secrets at once), so change both together.
